name: Shattered World (SWLPC 0.9.1)
english_description: Shattered World Core Mudlib (SWLPC 0.9.1, September 2001 GPLv2 release), the core library behind Australia's long-running Shattered World LPMud (1991), featuring Sanom City's Common Sleeping Quarters inn, clock tower view, Noisy Room, Storage, The Void, and the full RO/base, guild, combat, weather, and mail libraries.
